name: VideoVault Photoshop Extension
releaseNotes:
- Added open-file safety checks for server-hosted Photoshop files, with project-level presence tracking and immediate conflict warnings when another teammate is already in the same file
- Added stronger path normalization for UNC, `smb://`, and mapped-drive workflows so server files resolve more reliably before conflict checks run
- Kept the existing panel design intact while adding a compact Open file status row for clear, low-noise safety feedback
